blocks: Receives MIDI from external hardware. While the sequencer plays with Launchpad/UI/Area/1-Left/8-Record-Button on, notes arriving here are recorded into the sequencer.
Over USB, a computer reaches the MIDI jacks on the LPProMK3 DIN In/Out interface.
The Session button in the top row opens Session Mode: the grid shows an 8 × 8 window of the clips in Ableton Live's Session View, and pressing a pad launches its clip.
The Note button in the top row opens Note Mode: the grid plays melodic instruments and drums in a Chromatic, Scale or Drum layout that follows the instrument on the armed Live track.
The Chord button in the top row opens Chord Mode, which divides the grid into a Note Area of scale notes, an orange column of triads, and a white Chord Bank for saved chords.
The Custom button in the top row opens Custom Mode, which turns the grid into user-defined MIDI controls; the track-select buttons choose among eight layouts.
The Sequencer button in the top row opens the sequencer: four tracks that play at the same time, each with eight Patterns of 32 steps.
The four sequencer tracks play at the same time. Select one with its lit track-select button; the button and the track's Play Area share a color.
